Hi Tom / Laura,

Great to meet you both on today's discovery call 6 thanks for walking us through Acme Financial's high-level requirements and regulatory constraints. Quick recap/outcomes from our side: 

- Primary goal: Private VPC deployment (customer-managed network) for inference serving with audit logs and KMS integration.
- Must support SOC 2 controls and monthly audit log retention for 13 months.
- Peak inference load: ~1.8M tokens/day with spiky traffic for end-of-month reporting.
- Next step agreed: technical architecture review / deep dive with your infra and security leads to align on connectivity, routing, and data residency.

To keep momentum, could we schedule the Private/VPC architecture review next week? Rishi (SE) and Vivek (solutions) will run the deep dive and can cover topology options (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink), network requirements, firewall rules, and KMS/HSM integration.

Proposed 60-75 minute slots (all times PT):
- Tue 2026-05-05: 10:00-11:15 or 15:00-16:15
- Wed 2026-05-06: 09:00-10:15 or 14:00-15:15

Please let me know which slot works or share other times that fit your infra/security leads. Also, if you can share a short attendee list (names + roles) and any internal network diagrams or constraints (VPN/Bastion/IP allowlists), that'll help Rishi prepare.

I've attached a short overview of our Private deployment options to give your team context ahead of the call.

Thanks - looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
